provenance.structure: Table grid (rows, columns, edges) measured from the vector ruling lines in the PDF and cross-checked against the generator source (scripts/generate-corpus.ts, PDF-03): 6 horizontal and 5 vertical rules.
provenance.geometry: Text bounds are glyph-tight PDFium bounds; table bounds are the stroke-inclusive union of the rules (a 1pt stroke is reported as 2pt thick).
provenance.text: Cell text read from PDFium text objects binned into the measured grid and cross-checked against the generator formula.

limitations: Single page: header/footer and page-number detection needs at least 2 pages, so none can be expected.
Cell text for Q4 is '$1000,000' (no thousands separator on the million): it is what the generator wrote and is recorded as extracted, not corrected.

The table exists only as vector lines plus free text objects. There is no structure tree, so row/column counts come from the ruling lines, not from the text; text-only heuristics (e.g. extractTables in intelligence-operations.ts) cannot see the rules.
The first row is a header only by convention (no tagging); there are no merged cells in this fixture.
